capabilities: Create a dated meeting note with front matter, attendees and custom section headings
Scan every markdown file for unchecked checkbox lines and insert them at the cursor with links back to their source notes
Configure folder, date format, title format, default attendees and which heading holds action items
extras: The listing is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README ends by promoting the author's free calculators and templates site (getreadystack.com) rather than documenting more plugin behavior.
intentEvidence: Most meeting-note plugins sync from Outlook, Zoom, Granola or an AI service.
motivation: The author built it to avoid dependence on external meeting-note services that sync from Outlook, Zoom, Granola or AI services, which can change terms or be switched off.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate structured meeting notes or gather unchecked action items scattered across the vault into a single list.

relations.evidence: Most meeting-note plugins sync from Outlook, Zoom, Granola or an AI service.

summary: Offline meeting-notes plugin that creates a structured meeting note in one command and collects all open action items from the vault into one list.
